value.text:
q17.

`web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts`; `memoServiceClient`

This hook module holds all the memo CRUD operations — `useMemos`/`useInfiniteMemos` (list), `useMemo` (get), `useCreateMemo`, `useUpdateMemo`, `useDeleteMemo`, plus `useMemoComments`/`useInfiniteMemoComments` and `useLinkMetadata` — along with the `memoKeys` query-key factory used for cache management.

Every call goes through `memoServiceClient`, imported from `@/connect` on line 5. That client is created in `web/src/connect.ts` as a Connect-RPC client over the generated `MemoService` descriptor from `web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service_pb`:

```197:197:web/src/connect.ts
export const memoServiceClient = createClient(MemoService, transport);
```

Note that a couple of closely related concerns live in sibling modules rather than here: memo sharing uses `web/src/hooks/useMemoShareQueries.ts` and attachments use `web/src/hooks/useAttachmentQueries.ts`.
